title: Ten Weeks at the Window
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：form　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 form 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Our geography club wanted to understand one thing: how clouds ① form. Mr Cai said that every cloud begins with water vapour rising and cooling, and that heat travels through the atmosphere in several ② forms, some of which we can see and some of which we cannot.

We put a thermometer outside the lab window and took readings at seven, twelve and five. At first I thought I had to fill in a big ③ form for every reading; in fact one line in a notebook was enough. For weeks the expected shape refused to take ④ form, and I nearly gave up. Then we had ninety readings, and the numbers began to look like the graph in our textbook.

In July the heat arrived ⑤ in the form of eight days above forty degrees. The school asked every family for written permission before we could go out at midday, and the request came on a printed sheet to be signed twice. Our football team was in poor ⑥ form that summer too; nobody could run in that heat, least of all me, and nobody could form a sentence before eleven in the morning.

By September the change was plain. Rain no longer falls as long quiet showers: it now arrives as short violent storms. Blaming everything on fate, Mr Cai told us, is just another ⑦ form of giving up. He has watched since the drought of '22: the same amount of water now falls in half the time, and half of it runs straight off the fields.

So we ⑧ formed a small group and planted trees along the sports field, which does almost nothing for the climate but does a great deal for us. Asked what could really be done, Mr Cai said adaptation must first take shape in people's minds before it can take any shape in policy. '⑨ Form the habit of noticing one thing every day,' he said. 'After a year you will not need anybody's forecast.' I have kept that notebook ever since, and it still fills with poor ⑩ forms of weather — and no two months are alike, even though the same clouds form over the same hills every single day.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 形式；形态（多种外在表现）
C. n. 状态；竞技状态（in good/poor form）
D. n. 种类；类型（a form of ...）
F. v. 组成；结成（团队、组织）
G. 固定搭配：in the form of 以……的形式
H. 固定搭配：take form 成形；逐渐清晰

items.q: heat travels through the atmosphere in several forms
fill in a big form for every reading
the expected shape refused to take form
the heat arrived in the form of eight days
Our football team was in poor form
So we formed a small group
Form the habit of noticing one thing

answers.why: 主语是 clouds，是不及物动词“形成”，全文话题正是云如何生成。
in several forms 指热量的多种“形式、形态”，后接看得见与看不见两种。
fill in a form 是“填表格”，后文说其实记一行笔记就够了。
take form 是固定搭配，意为“成形、清晰起来”，说预期的曲线迟迟没出现。
in the form of＋具体内容，意为“以……的形式”，此处指热浪的具体表现。
in poor form 指竞技“状态不好”，用于球队，与天气炎热直接相关。
another form of＋抽象名词，意为“另一种……”，这里指另一种放弃的方式。
form＋宾语 a small group，是动词“组成、结成（团体）”。
form the habit of doing 意为“养成……的习惯”，此处老师要求学生每天观察。
poor forms of weather 指天气的各种形态，与第 2 题同属名词“形式；形态”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 云是水汽上升后形成的。（form v.）
那个夏天的酷热表现为连续八天四十度以上。（in the form of）
我原以为每次读数都得填一张大表格。（form n.）
那个图形过了好几周才成形。（take form）
那年夏天我们足球队的状态也很差。（in poor form）
养成每天观察一件小事的习惯。（form the habit of）
answers: Clouds form when water vapour rises and cools.
That summer the heat came in the form of eight days above forty degrees.
I thought I had to fill in a big form for every reading.
The pattern took form only after several weeks.
Our football team was in poor form that summer too.
Form the habit of noticing one small thing every day.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 form 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Our club wanted to know how clouds form, since heat travels through the atmosphere in several forms.
I soon learned to fill in one line rather than a big form for every reading.
The expected shape of our graph refused to take form for weeks, and I nearly gave up.
In July the heat came in the form of eight days above forty degrees, and our team was in poor form too.
Blaming everything on fate is just another form of giving up, Mr Cai said after the drought.
So we formed a small group, planted trees, and formed the habit of recording the rainfall every single day.
